notes: Omen opens on Helm by default (CEO 2026-09-30, "default to helm"), and a new Omen opens at 1280×720 when no size has been chosen.

Omen's editor steps through Layout, Position, Layers and Configure. Layout shows the five experiences as pictures your portal draws with this machine's readings; picking one shows its styles as pictures, and a click switches the portal.

Position has "Place on display" back (Omen moves to the display you pick and takes its size, in real pixels or Windows' scaled size as Size units says) and the resolution grid (orientation, then sizes, or Custom).
